claude-code/q3-announced.class: the client received an MCP server's tools/list_changed notification (per-server MCP debug log under the client's cache)

claude-code/q3-silent--changed.class: AUXILIARY to claude-code/q3-silent (referenced by its 'changed' field, not a rule of its own): an MCP tool's definition (description, input schema) in a transcript differs from its earlier definition in the same project

claude-code/q3-silent.class: an MCP tool's definition in a transcript differs from its earlier definition in the same project, with no tools/list_changed notification logged between the two observations

claude-code/q5-start.class: an MCP server whose name never had a per-server log directory before is started (first-ever start of a server name)

codex/q3-announced.class: the client received a ToolListChangedNotification from an MCP server ('MCP server tool list changed')

codex/q3-silent.reason: Codex's default logs never record an MCP tool's description or schema (no definition text in logs_*.sqlite, sessions rollouts, history or state databases), and a silent change produces no notification; no record after the event differs in kind from normal-use records.

codex/q5-start.class: an MCP server name never started before in the log database gets a start_server_task span (first-ever start of a server name)

gemini/q3-announced.class: an info record 'Tools updated for server' in a chat transcript: the CLI refreshed a server's tools after its list-changed notification

gemini/q3-silent.reason: Gemini CLI's default logs (logs.json, chats) record neither tool definitions nor tool-list refreshes without a notification; in both silent runs the records after the event are ordinary user/model/info chat records also present in normal use.

gemini/q5-start.reason: In both runs where the project's server was started, Gemini CLI wrote no timed record at all between t0 and t1 (no chat, no logs.json entry, no log line): nothing in the default logs marks the start.

goose/q3-announced.class: a tool declaration sent to the model differs from the earlier declaration of the same tool (llm_request logs); Goose logs no list-changed notification, so this is the same signal as goose/q3-silent

goose/q3-silent.class: a tool declaration sent to the model differs from the earlier declaration of the same tool (llm_request logs)

goose/q5-start.class: a session's enabled extensions (sessions.db extension_data) include a stdio extension name never enabled in an earlier session

qwen/q3-announced.class: an MCP tool definition returned by tool_search differs from the earlier one of the same tool in the same project; Qwen logs no list-changed notification, so this is the same signal as qwen/q3-silent

qwen/q3-silent.class: an MCP tool definition returned by tool_search differs from the earlier one of the same tool in the same project

qwen/q5-start.reason: When Qwen Code started the project's server, the only record in the run is the session's runtime.json (pid, work_dir, start time; dated by file mtime, before the event); no default log names or reports an MCP server start.
